name: fuzzy-file-search-joel
title: Fuzzy File Search Local
description: Fuzzy-search files by full path, and open pasted paths directly.
author: erykksc

commands.name: search-for-files
commands.title: Search Files Local
commands.description: Fuzzy-find files and folders by path using the fsearch daemon's live whole-disk index.

preferences.name: includeDirectories
preferences.title: Include Directories
preferences.label: Search for both directories and files
preferences.description: If enabled, the search results will include files and directories. If disabled, the search will only look for files.

preferences.name: customSearchDirs
preferences.title: Custom Search Directories
preferences.description: The list of directories to start in. The search will run in all of those directories. Separate each directory with a whitespace ' '

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
